referenceSources.title: WESTHILL MOTORSPORTS: ホンダシビックＥＫ９レシングカーの販売　HONDA CIVIC EK9 Type R
referenceSources.description:
A white Honda Civic EK9 Type R racing car is parked outside a garage, showcasing its Westhill Motorsports livery and the race number 96 prominently on the hood. Sponsor decals from Direzza, Pirelli, WAKO’S, and Racing Gear line the front bumper and side skirts, while a red tow hook adds a functional racing detail.

Built to JAF N1 specifications, this track-prepared Civic features expired safety equipment including seat belts and a safety fuel tank. Its last sanctioned competition was the 2010 Tsukuba P1600 race. Offered for sale at 2,000,000 yen, the car represents a well-documented piece of grassroots Japanese motorsport history.
